outcome: Successful vaginal delivery following labor induction
cohort: 235 nulliparous women at 38 gestational weeks or more with intact membranes who delivered vaginally following labor induction
finding: Cervical funneling, similar to Bishop score and cervical length, was an independent predictor of successful vaginal delivery after labor induction.
mod_finding: This study focused on predicting successful vaginal delivery after labor induction and did not compare different modes of delivery.
